Overview

Haapsalu is a city in Lääne County with a population of 10,000. A picturesque coastal resort town on the Baltic Sea, known for its historic bishop’s castle, healing mud baths, charming wooden architecture, and the Kuursaal promenade. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
